title: Finite-dimensional scalar model of first additive etale cohomology
statement: Let f:C → Spec(k) be a smooth connected curve over an algebraically closed field k [def-sc-curves]. Let G be a sheaf of abelian groups in coefficient universe u+1 on the small etale site, with natural additive equivalences a_U:G(U) ≃ Γ(U,O_U). Write T for the degree-one derived etale cohomology functor on sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. There exists a k-module structure on T(G) which is finite-dimensional, and for every c in k there exists a sheaf endomorphism μ_c whose value on sections under a_U is multiplication by the pullback of c along U → C → Spec(k), and whose map on T(G) is scalar multiplication by c. This statement has no positive-characteristic, Frobenius, or surjectivity assertion.

proof.text: For each c in k, construct μ_c on sections as a_U inverse composed with multiplication by the pullback of c and a_U. Naturality of the structure ring maps and ha proves sheaf-map naturality. Check the zero, unit, addition, and composition identities sectionwise. Apply the additive cohomology functor to these identities and use the additive group homomorphism laws to construct every axiom of Module k on T(G). The action is definitionally T(μ_c).

Apply lem-sc-additive-cohomology-finite-dimensional to the module structure just constructed and its scalar section formulas. Return that module, its finite-dimensionality and the actual scalar sheaf endomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A3N proof; K1 proves the section-induced module structure, with finiteness isolated separately.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finiteDimensional_etaleCohomology_one_scalar_model {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (a : ∀ U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤)) (ha : ∀ (U V : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U), a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x)) : let T := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0 ⋙ Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} C (1 : ℤ) ∃ m : Module k (T.obj G), let := m FiniteDimensional k (T.obj G) ∧ ∀ c : k, ∃ μ : G ⟶ G, (∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U), let ρ : k →+* Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤) := U.unop.hom.appTop.hom.comp (f.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom) a U (μ.hom.app U x) = a U x * ρ c) ∧ ∀ x : T.obj G, T.map μ x = c • x
